title: On the generalized Sierpiński and Riesel numbers
summary: In this paper, we prove that for any fixed base $b \ge 2$, there exists an infinite arithmetic progression of positive integers $k$ that are simultaneously generalized Sierpiński and generalized Riesel numbers in base $b$. More precisely, we construct such an arithmetic progression so that both $k\cdot b^n + 1$ and $k\cdot b^n - 1$ have at least two distinct prime factors for every positive integer $n$. Our approach uses covering systems, following the ideas of Erdős and later constructions of Harrington. The argument is then completed using Zsigmondy's theorem on primitive divisors together…
